mentions.name: Mimic Scribe
mentions.description: An on-device speech transcriber built on a custom-trained Parakeet Ultra model that has the model output digits in spoken form to fix the model family's digit recognition issues, plus a harness that better merges consecutive 15-second transcription windows for improved accuracy.
mentions.problem: Parakeet-family ASR models have issues with digits, producing inaccurate transcriptions of numbers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm trying to build "the most accurate on-device transcriber". I'm doing a custom train of Parakeet Ultra that fixes the model families' issues with digits by having the model output them in spoken form. I'm also trying to get the harness it sits in to better merge the 15s windows. https://mimicscribe.app/
